title: MSc Accounting and Finance at University of Birmingham Dubai
text:
Invest in a global career and reshape the future with our MSc Accounting and Finance degree.
The world of accounting and finance is ever-changing, with practice constantly evolving to deal with the major challenges the world is facing. Our programme will strengthen your existing knowledge, develop your skillset in accounting and finance, and prepare you for a successful global career.
Accredited by the United Arab Emirates Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research
You are entitled to the following ACCA qualification exemptions on successful completion of the MSc Accounting and Finance:
Business and Technology
Management Accounting
Financial Accounting
Corporate and Business Law
Course Structure
This course will run over 12 months in a full-time mode or 24 months in a part-time mode.
Course Highlights
Our MSc Accounting and Finance programme is designed to produce specialists equipped with the intellectual, analytical, communication, and ethical proficiencies essential for a distinguished career in accounting and finance.
This course will develop your understanding of the principal theories and empirical research that form the foundation of accounting and finance.
You will also master a variety of methodologies to address and resolve real-world challenges.
Additionally, you will acquire a suite of transferable skills, including critical analysis, effective communication, and teamwork.
Accounting and Finance graduates are in high demand from a wide range of top employers for their specialist skills.
Opportunity to meet and network with leading global organisations.
Our modules cover topics at the forefront of emerging trends in accounting and finance. Our course has been developed by leading researchers in the field, with a focus on sustainable and responsible business practices.
Start Date:
September 2027 (full-time or part-time)
Fees:
AED 180,617 (full-time) per year / AED 90,309 (part-time) per year
Join our next Open Day:
Saturday 14 November 2026
Entry Requirements:
An Honours degree (2:1 or higher) or Postgraduate Diploma in Accounting or Finance related subjects.
